name: mb dialog: the lift is never added
why: _ensureMbDialogZStyle() is not called at init: the dialog stays at jQuery UI's 100.

name: mb dialog: the lift stops under the sidebar handle
why: The overlay goes to 9000: above the bars, still under the handle (10000).

name: mb dialog: the lift outranked by .ui-front
why: The rule loses its body-level part and ties .ui-front: MusicBrainz's later stylesheet wins.

name: mb dialog: dialog and overlay at one level
why: Both at the same z-index: the dialog still wins, being later in DOM order. The +1 only guards against a dialog MusicBrainz might insert before its overlay; the spec cannot see it, recorded.
